title: studio-call/v1 response
description: The answer of one walled model call, with a receipt that names how it was billed.

text.description: The model's answer. At most max_output_bytes of the request, counted in UTF-8.

billing_class.description: The call runs on the user's own subscription seat. Any other class is refused by the caller.

money.description: Optional. What the call cost in money terms: virtual, never real.
